limitations: Costs are estimates from configured upstream prices; payment fees, refunds, FX and labor are not included (gross, not net).
Logs created before the first cost rule have cost_quota=0; the UI shows cost_tracking_since and warns.
If the log database is switched to ClickHouse, logs.cost_quota needs a manual migration.
Monthly/yearly projections are extrapolations from elapsed days, not guarantees.
